rationale: Both parties agree that pull requests invoke a SHA-pinned reusable workflow and map the organization Cloudflare credentials into it; the dispute is whether that external workflow exposes those credentials to PR-controlled execution or lets PR configuration alter production resources. `.github/workflows/pull-request.yml:20-23` shows only the opaque reusable-workflow call and secret mapping, while `.github/deployment-policy.jsonc:20-26` names candidate/release targets but does not establish the called workflow's execution or credential scope, so the claimed takeover path is unproven and the finding is dismissed.
title: Keep production Cloudflare credentials out of pull-request deployments
